notes.title: DEV LOG #9 \\ UV REWORK, MAP CHANGES, AND MORE
notes.notes:
It's been a pretty crazy last few weeks, But i've still been able to get quite a bit of work done!
I'll just get right into it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"]UV REWORK  \[ DONE ]
Previously, UV Evidence would spawn at set locations, with some slight variations.

Now, UV can spawn on any wall, floor, (maybe even ceiling) or door within it's reach, While this might sound like it's Too Much, this actually makes UV evidence much more consistent, And in some cases quicker to get. It also makes items like The Tripod more useful.  While testing is mostly complete, I am working on adding more places for the evidence to spawn. (Like Tables, Chairs, Etc.)
There are patterns to where it spawns, But you'll need to learn these yourself!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"]
MAP CHANGES
I decided to add a bit more Detail to The House, and The Ghost Ship. (also did a Lighting & texture update to The Diner)

The House, the backstory behind the location is basically "it was a long-abandoned house (How original) and a new family bought it, and were in the process of restoring it when they noticed Paranormal activity." And now, I feel like it more accurately fits that story. With flooring and carpet being replaced, and Walls being replaced. Here's a look! 
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/6a1a1895e99e6ef617c1c477710893d0646a9e77.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/777988eab16538ba89f63a0864ed4a0a58775212.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d21040fb0c9a05bfda643f5efa55ba964f079f48.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/da4c198414fe27ab61310c739faf048269b92c83.png"][/carousel]


The Ghost Ship, With Scripted UV going away, the rest area really needed some more things for the ghost to leave prints on, so... I added some crates, and a few extra surf boards. It also got some new Lights in the indoor sections.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/0034d04d7f9da802d2102b32a24ccb4c80da1a80.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/1dbf2bc9242e8cb7fa07ce3fcab9d07f54d7b5dc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/838d5899c6c4f94606a6beaa1e1516bbb39ea04d.png"][/carousel]


The Diner, New Ceiling lights, and updated Kitchen textures. No more chrome stoves or counters.

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/04c4b4a061e5a04d18b02eb28a1078484503cc7f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/885eb9be8631ca8492b17df3f5d8195b847631ee.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/0eddcdb247c2f14e687a600a277986c7b3193ba7.png"][/carousel]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"]
THE CAVE
The cave is coming along very well, pretty much all I need to do is add interactables, and a bit of extra detail.

And I do have a final set of teasers to share, but I wanted to talk about something first,
I've been thinking a lot about how much I want to share about upcoming maps image wise,
And I think I'm going to share minimal details about them from now on, to give y'all a better experience when playing them for the first time.

I'll still be showing some shots just to give y'all an idea of the maps though,
just not "here's every room in the map," here's the ghost rooms," etc.
I'll probably be keeping some bigger set pieces (Like the waterfall) secret too.

Anyway, Here's the final teasers for The Cave.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/78e7068f69107844ec9843933d8004df2ce9398a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/8e4a0ca0043e683056f930c8815807b64c283fb7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/6136b0bc65c057d861c4e741b4cacbda50752f41.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/bb923675d2429a4b1a5348f4846916b5dd651ecd.png"][/carousel]
 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"]MISC
Audio Settings have been added

Added in a Main Menu, Menu Theme, and Intro 'Video'
Also added an ability to Disable the Intro video, and even disable the Main Menu.

Improved Door feel, and physics. Also improved the ghost's interaction with it.

Models and textures have been further optimized, And improved in quality.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"]
[strike]10[/strike] 8 STEPS BEFORE RELEASE[olist]
Player Controller rework  \[ DONE ]

Book Rework  \[ DONE ]

EMF Rework  \[ DONE ]

UV Rework  \[ DONE ]

Stress System rework  \[ DONE ]

2 New Maps: The School, The Cave  \[ 45% ]

Hunt System  \[ 20% ]  & Ghost Models  \[ Model 1 of 4 Complete ]

Steam Page overhaul & Trailer

Arcade Games  \[ POST RELEASE ]

Photo System  \[ POST RELEASE ]
[/olist]
As you can see, I did decide to push back the Arcade Games and Photo System until post-release. These will likely be in the first major update though!
(By post release, I mean Early Access, Not V1.0!)

 
No promises yet, but I'm still aiming for a late August release,
But as I mentioned before, I won't release it until I'm 100% happy with the state it's in.

Anyway, that's all for now! Dev Log 10 will be the Final dev log before release!

notes.title: What's in the Works for PHANTOM // The final steps until Release
notes.notes:
So, if you've been following the game for awhile you probably know development on PHANTOM is paused while I finish up my Free Game, Aftermath. As I wanted to get it out of the way before I started offering PHANTOM as a paid product.

And I'm happy to say I'm working on the Very Last gameplay section for the free game, After that, 100% of my dev time will be on PHANTOM!

Here's what's left before phantom is ready for Early Access, In Order.

1: Player Controller rework
    New Player model, Animations, future-proofing, and QoL


2: Finishing the UV Rework
     The current UV system is Distance Based, but the new system I'm implementing is Light Based,
     Meaning, the Color, and intensity of the light is what shows Handprints, Footprints, etc.


3: UI Rework
    For the 'Safe House' I'm wanting to put less emphasis on the Ghost Tab.
    Map Selection, and Upgrades will be moved to the Main Monitor,
    As well as a better Results/End screen. 

4: 2 new maps
    I've already concepted the last 2 maps needed for early access,
    But...I do have ideas for 2 Bonus maps I could include at Launch, But...Just expect the main 2. 


5: Marketing
    Trailer, and social media posts.

MISC: Game Page rework, discord Rework 


For the Total Content available at Launch:
15 Upgrades, 5 Maps, 6 Main Items, 3 Unlockable Items

I'm aiming for a July/August release, But I won't release it until I'm 100% happy with it.





Anyway, I think that's all for now. I'm working on a new Dev Log that'll be going up in the next few weeks, after I finish up the Free game.


Thanks for reading!




If you haven't already, there's an Alpha build you can try out if you'd like.


If you have any other questions, Feel free to comment here, or check out the discord server

notes.title: DEV LOG #6 \\ WEATHER SYSTEM, LIGHTING UPDATE, PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
WEATHER SYSTEM & LIGHTING UPDATE:
I've added in a weather system, Rain, Snow, Fog, ETC
The weather is randomized at the start of each round, and can change during it.
I.E: You can go from Clear to Rainy, and maybe even to Snowy from there.

As well as this weather system, I've also improved the lighting in each map.

Here's a couple photos of what the new system looks like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b8570f691794c88fce64406499c32245a418380e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/225de8ecea1aa31f5b418e83e481ef75d4cdc299.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d7c8698c22905f0a32512a0b84aef2e5c6eded17.png

PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS:
The polycount has been reduced by ~50K per location.
Textures have all been optimized as well, going from 4K to 1K & 2K without a noticeable difference.
I've also improved the FSR Implementation, and added in DLSS.


All of these changes, and Many More are available for y'all to play in a Public Alpha!
If you'd like, you can check it out here

I'm pretty happy with how everything turned out, Especially the tutorial area, Since i feel it's a pretty commonly overlooked feature in other ghost hunting games, often being too much info at one time, or not enough.
I feel it has a pretty good explanation of the games mechanics, as well as examples of All Main and Side evidence.
But, even if i feel it's a good tutorial, that decision ultimately lands on the players to decide.
It may be updated as time goes on to improve various aspects, especially when hunts are finalized.


UV System
UV now shows much brighter, has Much less fade, and now Distance based instead of Overlap based.
You can see how UV looks via the image above


WHATS NEXT?
I'll be polishing up The Ghost Ship, and Diner map starting Today.
within the next month or so, I'll be uploading a Alpha Build to the gamejolt page,
More on that in a later post.

Pretty soon, i'll also be adding in the hunt system,
implementing the Leveling system i mentioned in the previous dev log,
Adding the ability to leave levels,
and finishing up the Stats menu.

Neither the Hunt system, all of the stats or Leveling system will likely be present in the Alpha.
